text.p: These are the leading stories in the Mozambican press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The Mozambican parliament failed to complete the second reading of a government bill establishing local elections in 33 towns, due to an avalanche of complaints from the opposition Renamo, which wants the list expanded.
- Floods have affected 50,000 people in the northern Nampula province, where six people have died and around 15,000 hectares of crops have been lost.
